_comment: Public 0.2.0 brings the native 0.164.0-r58 runtime and bundled-Python Claude runtime claude-r32. Build from the reviewed source snapshot; components are discovered from component.json and filtered by the public component-release-policy (DSH and Kimi omitted for this release). The asks format v2 migration cannot be rolled back by an older updater; require explicit one-way confirmation. Restore to an older release requires an offline data restoration procedure.

notes.en: Updates durable agent communication to format v2. Older releases require an offline restoration before they can read it; automatic rollback across this update is unavailable.
notes.zh-CN: 持久化智能体通信升级为格式 v2。旧版本需要先离线恢复数据才能读取，不能跨过本次更新自动回退。

notes.en: Persistent agent communication and delegation improvements, project-owned services, account-aware Profiles and runtime variants, and native runtime 0.164.0-r58. Claude runtime claude-r32 bundles Python and its pinned dependencies. Kimi and DSH are experimental and are not included in 0.2.0 binaries; they are planned for a later public update. Existing agents keep their pinned runtime until explicitly moved. Read the one-way migration notice before upgrading from 0.1.5. In kimi-r2 on Linux the node-pty binding is absent, so interactive terminal tools are unavailable; offline Glob/Grep require system rg.
notes.zh-CN: 改进持久化智能体通信与委托，支持项目服务、按账户管理的 Profile 和运行时变体，并提供原生运行时 0.164.0-r58。Claude 运行时 claude-r32 自带 Python 和固定依赖；Kimi 和 DSH 为实验功能，不包含在 0.2.0 二进制发行中，计划随后续公开更新提供。现有智能体保留固定运行时，直到明确迁移。从 0.1.5 升级前请阅读不可自动回退的迁移说明。 kimi-r2 的 Linux 包缺少 node-pty 扩展，交互式终端工具不可用；离线 Glob/Grep 需系统 rg。
